total_supply.meaning: total staked token supply in the gauge
total_supply.checkpoint: before reward accrual during empty period

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with gauge supply zero and no deposits

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add new rewards during the empty period

emissions_claimable.meaning: reward emissions distributed during zero-supply periods remain claimable by users rather than trapped
emissions_claimable.checkpoint: after empty period and subsequent deposits

token_allocation_wasted.meaning: low-liquidity gauge wastes significant token allocations over time due to repeated emptying

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount is the mechanism by which reward emissions are added during the empty period.
The gauge may empty and refill repeatedly over time for low-liquidity gauges.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact ordering of notifyRewardAmount versus rewardPerToken/updateReward calls during the empty period, so the precise accrual-skip trigger is not fully determined.
Report does not quantify 'significant token allocations' or the frequency of emptying for low-liquidity gauges; represented as a grounded Boolean outcome.

limitations: Impact i_low_liquidity_waste is potential and aggregate over time; the plan encodes the qualitative waste outcome rather than a numeric magnitude.
Other impacts (i_epoch_stuck, i_full_epoch_unclaimable, i_skipped_unclaimable_after_deposit) are not formalized by this plan.
